NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author started a CZO thread and linked it in the PR description. There was no new push, and the code is unchanged.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |

| ❌  | The thread only has the author's own post. No maintainer has said the approach is wanted. |
| ❌  | "Fixes:" is empty, and "How changes were tested" only says "Verified no test failures". |
| ℹ️  | The same author's PR #40042 makes a similar change, so the two PRs may need to be combined or one closed. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and wait for a maintainer to respond in the CZO thread. If one says the change is wanted, the PR can move on after the description is fixed.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for starting the discussion thread! Please wait for a maintainer to weigh in there on whether this approach is wanted. Meanwhile, please fill in the PR template properly: how you tested the change, and whether #40042 should be merged into this PR.
```
